description: This file contains a JUnit test class 'CustomSSLContextTest' that extends 'AbstractSSLContextTest'. It tests the creation of custom SSLContext instances with specified trust managers and key managers, focusing on SSL/TLS configurations using mock objects.

classes.name: CustomSSLContextTest
classes.description: A test class for creating SSLContext instances with custom trust and key managers for SSL/TLS testing purposes.
